scenes.title: *No one* aboard
scenes.say: December 1872. A ship is found drifting in the Atlantic. Its sails are up. Its cargo is still there. But all ten people on board are gone.

scenes.title: The *lifeboat* was gone
scenes.say: The Mary Celeste was found by another ship, the Dei Gratia, between the Azores and Portugal. Her lifeboat was missing, and the last log entry was from more than a week before.

scenes.title: His *wife and daughter*
scenes.say: Captain Benjamin Briggs had brought his wife and young daughter, along with seven crew. None of them was ever seen again.

scenes.title: The *theories*:
scenes.say: The theories: pirates, a mutiny, insurance fraud, even a sea monster. But a British inquiry in Gibraltar found no evidence of foul play.

scenes.title: The verdict:
scenes.text: Best guess: they *abandoned ship* in a panic.
scenes.say: Many historians think the crew feared the ship was sinking, or that the cargo of alcohol was dangerous, and took to the lifeboat. But no one knows for sure. The verdict: unsolved.
